metadata.title: Network Access Control

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability enabling controlled admission of systems, devices, and workloads to the institutional network.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Network access control, identity-aware admission, and enforcement platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Policy-driven network admission control enforcing identity, device, and context-aware access decisions.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Network admission decisions, authentication context, posture signals, and access state metadata.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network access decisions are identity-aware, context-sensitive, and independent of network location, consistent with Zero Trust Architecture principles.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network Access Control implements policy-driven, dynamically evaluated admission consistent with Zero Trust Networking guidance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Remote and non-local access admission aligns with SP 800-46 guidance modernized through identity-aware enforcement.

metadata.remarks: Network Access Control defines the capability responsible for determining whether a system, device, workload, or user session may be granted network connectivity. It evaluates identity, authentication context, device posture, and environmental signals prior to admission. This pattern does not define policy content, segmentation, or inspection logic, which are handled by dependent Secure Network patterns.

components.title: Admission Decision
components.description: Evaluation of access requests to determine whether network connectivity may be granted.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid credentials to gain unauthorized network admission.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Conditional admission decisions restrict network access based on identity and context.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorize network access only after validating identity and context.

components.title: Posture and Context Evaluation
components.description: Assessment of device posture, authentication strength, and environmental signals as part of admission decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of trusted devices lacking adequate posture validation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Evaluation of device state prior to granting network access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Verify authentication and supporting contextual signals before access.

components.title: Access State Enforcement
components.description: Enforcement and maintenance of network access state following admission.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through unauthorized modification of access states.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous enforcement and reassessment of network access state.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce approved access states and revoke access upon policy violation.
